mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO telemetry_value_archive ( sample_at, variable_name, numeric_value, raw_value, metric_kind_code, room_canonical, bundle_code, schema_version, ingest_batch_id, ext_json ) VALUES
(#{item.sampleAt}, #{item.variableName}, #{item.numericValue}, #{item.rawValue}, #{item.metricKindCode}, #{item.roomCanonical}, #{item.bundleCode}, #{item.schemaVersion}, #{item.ingestBatchId}, #{item.extJson})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM telemetry_value_archive WHERE sample_at < #{cutoff}

SELECT id, sample_at, variable_name, numeric_value, raw_value, metric_kind_code, room_canonical, bundle_code, schema_version, ingest_batch_id, ext_json FROM telemetry_value_archive
ORDER BY sample_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT room_canonical AS roomCanonical, metric_kind_code AS metricKindCode, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(variable_name ORDER BY sample_at DESC), ',', 1) AS variable_name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(numeric_value ORDER BY sample_at DESC), ',', 1) + 0 AS latest_value, MIN(numeric_value) AS min_value, MAX(numeric_value) AS max_value, AVG(numeric_value) AS avg_value, COUNT(1) AS sample_count, MAX(sample_at) AS latest_at FROM telemetry_value_archive WHERE sample_at >= #{from} AND sample_at <= #{to} AND room_canonical IS NOT NULL AND room_canonical != '' AND numeric_value IS NOT NULL
AND metric_kind_code = #{metricKindCode}
AND room_canonical LIKE CONCAT(#{floorFilter}, '%')
GROUP BY room_canonical, metric_kind_code

SELECT id, sample_at, variable_name, numeric_value, raw_value, metric_kind_code, room_canonical, bundle_code, schema_version, ingest_batch_id, ext_json FROM telemetry_value_archive WHERE sample_at >= #{from} AND sample_at <= #{to} AND numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND room_canonical IS NOT NULL
AND metric_kind_code = #{metricKindCode}
AND room_canonical LIKE CONCAT(#{floorFilter}, '%')
ORDER BY sample_at ASC LIMIT 50000
